item.title: The Westin Hyderabad Mindspace Appoints Simranjit Singh as Head of Beverages
item.description: Hyderabad, India, 05th February 2026 – The Westin Hyderabad Mindspace has announced the appointment of Simranjit Singh as Head of Beverages, further strengthening its leadership team and reaffirming its commitment to delivering elevated dining and beverage experiences. With over a decade of experience across leading luxury hotels and fine dining restaurants in India and Dubai, Simranjit Singh brings extensive expertise in beverage operations, wine program development, and guest-centric service.
